summary_zh: 开源一体化 Agent 聊天机器人平台：可在 IM 工作流中接入 QQ、企业微信、飞书、钉钉、Telegram、Slack 等主流即时通讯平台，提供 LLM 对话、多模态、Agent、知识库、插件扩展、Agent 沙箱、WebUI 与 Web ChatUI，并支持对接 Dify、百炼、Coze 等平台。
audience_zh: 适合希望快速搭建 IM 内 AI 应用的个人、开发者与团队，可用于个人 AI 伙伴、智能客服、自动化助手或企业知识库。

evidence.quote: AstrBot is an open-source all-in-one Agent chatbot platform that integrates with mainstream instant messaging apps. It provides reliable and scalable conversational AI infrastructure for individuals, developers, and teams. Whether you're building a personal AI companion, intelligent customer service
, automation assistant, or enterprise knowledge base, AstrBot enables you to quickly build production-ready AI applications within your IM platform workflows.
4. 🌐 Multi-Platform: QQ, WeChat Work, Feishu, DingTalk, WeChat Official Accounts, Telegram, Slack, and [more](#supported-messaging-platforms).
2. ✨ AI LLM Conversations, Multimodal, Agent, MCP, Skills, Knowledge Base, Persona Settings, Auto Context Compression.
